headword: {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}
reading: えいようほじょしょくひん

definitions.explanation: A food product taken to supplement the diet with vitamins, minerals, or other nutrients. Built from {栄養|えいよう} (nutrition) + {補助|ほじょ} (supplementary aid) + {食品|しょくひん} (food product).

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}を{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I take dietary supplements every day.

examples.japanese: {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}は{薬|くすり}ではない。
{食事|しょくじ}だけで{足|た}りない{栄養|えいよう}は、{栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}で{補|おぎな}うとよい。
examples.english: It's good to make up for nutrients you can't get from meals alone with dietary supplements.

notes:
The formal Japanese term for a dietary supplement, common on product labels and in health writing. In casual speech, the loanword サプリ (or サプリメント) is far more frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}を{摂|と}る: to take a dietary supplement
- {栄養|えいよう}を{補|おぎな}う: to supplement nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サプリメント / サプリ: supplement — the everyday loanword for the same thing
- {健康食品|けんこうしょくひん}: health food — a broader category of foods marketed for health benefits
